common.daily_values: direct integer draws remain integers; continuous proposals use np.rint (ties-to-even), then clip to support
common.deduplication: distinct within each scenario / stratum; risk distinct across five risk categories; merged full sequences unique, retaining first occurrence in scenario,stratified,risk order
common.interpretation: proposal distributions plus explicit final constraints; conditionally accepted profiles need not remain iid
common.category_interpretation: source categories identify generation and acceptance rules; groups can overlap in realized temperature properties and counts are design quotas, not occurrence probabilities

scenario.rule: c~D[-18,-1]; daily c+D[-1,1], rounded and clipped to [-18,-1]
c~D[0,4]; daily c+D[-1,1], rounded and clipped to [0,4]
start D[-18,10], end D[min(18,start+4),18]; linear baseline+N(0,0.7^2). Hold n, redraw parameters/noise until final predicate
tau D[1,n-1]; low D[-18,8], high D[min(18,low+8),18]; switch centers; integer perturb D[-1,1]
scenario.predicate: switch from a lower segment to a higher segment

scenario.rule: tau D[1,n-2]; start D[-18,8], peak D[min(18,start+6),18], end D[-18,max(-18,peak-3)]; piecewise linear; no daily noise
low D[-18,8], high D[min(18,low+8),18]; daily alternation+integer perturb D[-2,2]
same low/high; block=max(2,floor(n/3)); alternate blocks+integer perturb D[-1,1]
l D[1,min(3,n)]; tau=max(1,n-l); low D[-18,8], high D[min(18,low+6),18]; initial low; tail linspace(high-2,high,n-tau); one-point tail equals high-2
scenario.predicate: initial stable segment, late increasing segment

scenario.rule: tau D[1,n-1], negative center D[-18,-1], positive center D[1,18], D[-1,1] daily noise; reverse p=.5; hold n, redraw until actual crossing
scenario.predicate: at least one adjacent negative/nonnegative sign transition

scenario.rule: baseline D[-2,8]; k D[1,n] different random positions replaced with D[15,18]

stratified.duration: discrete uniform within layer intersected with n>=1 stable, n>=2 warming/cooling, n>=3 oscillating; hold n through rejection
stratified.daily_perturbation: independent proposal U(-a,a), before integer rounding; quantization can change deviation by up to 0.5 degree
stratified.a_baseline_role: existing endpoint offsets and sinusoidal amplitude also retained; a now bounds the added daily perturbation in all rules
stratified.acceptance: final integers must contain >=1 value in target band AND satisfy nondecreasing/net warming, nonincreasing/net cooling, or >=1 sign change among nonzero daily differences. Stable means a constant baseline with added daily jitter, not all days in the target band. No arbitrary day overwrite

risk.rule: daily N(6,3^2), round/clip; hold n and redraw all daily values until at least one 4<T<=8
baseline N(11,4^2), round/clip; k=max(1,floor(n/3)) different random positions replaced by D[9,15]
risk.predicate: at least one actual 9..15 day; other days can fall outside this range

risk.rule: baseline D[-3,12]; k~D[ceil(.25*n),floor(.70*n)]; k distinct random positions replaced by D[15,18]
risk.predicate: 25%..70% of actual days at 15..18; remaining days -3..12; exposed days need not be consecutive

risk.rule: alternating daily D[-18,-1] / D[0,12]; reverse p=.5
risk.predicate: daily negative/nonnegative transitions; no physical freeze-thaw inference

baselines.SRS: n~D[1,10], daily T~D[-18,18]; reject duplicate complete sequences
baselines.Sobol: scrambled 11D; generate 2^ceil(log2(N)) and use first N
baselines.OA-LHS: complete prime-q strength-2 OA-LHS q^2>=N, q>=d-1; random row permutation and first N; subset not claimed strength-2
baselines.MaxPro: scrambled random LHS; attempt 4N random single-coordinate row swaps, accept only strict reduction of pair penalty; floor differences 1e-14, cap exponent700, no early stop
baselines.mapping: Sobol/OA-LHS/MaxPro only: duration=floor(10*u)+1; T=rint(-18+36*u), clip; take first n daily coordinates
baselines.dedup_and_supplement: all unique complete sequences; supplement with unique SRS if needed
